title: Retire vapor: remove the Vapor log, the No vapor stamp and the hype gap
description:
Remove the vapor framing from the public site.

Changes:
- Delete `web/pages/vapor.md` and its page entry, the Vapor log nav link, and the "No vapor" stamp in `nav.brandHtml` (`web/projection.json`).
- Redirect `/vapor/` to `/new/`.
- Remove `_hype_gap` and `_hype_gap_html` from `web/hooks.py`, along with their CSS and tests.
- Remove `hypeGap` from the reader-steering plugin in `papyrus.config.ts` and from `web/scoring.json`. Without it, Papyrus publishes no hype gap (see Papyrus `docs/reader-steering.md`).
- Remove vapor sample rows from `web/pages/rising.md` and the sample pages.

Acceptance:
- No live page contains "vapor" or "hype gap", checked by curl over the sitemap.
- `/vapor/` redirects to `/new/`.
- `tests/test_hooks.py` passes.
